verses.translation: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

verses.arabicText: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah
verses.translation: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

verses.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
verses.transliteration: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba
verses.translation: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
